items.headline: Source: Texans' Nico Collins (hamstring) uncertain for Week 2
items.description: Texans star wide receiver Nico Collins suffered a hamstring injury during Wednesday's practice and is uncertain to play in Week 2 against the Bengals, a source told ESPN.

items.headline: Kyrie offers to pay Al-Shaair's fine for tribute to Hind Rajab
items.description: Kyrie Irving offered to pay Texans LB Azeez Al-Shaair's $11,941 fine for having the name of a Palestinian girl killed in Gaza in 2024 written on his eye black during a game.
